component.name: Concat
component.summary: Free and open source video editor

description.p: Concat is a free, open source video editor and a CapCut alternative for Linux. It covers what people actually open CapCut for: auto-captions, text-to-speech, background removal, keyframe animation, effects and titles, multi-track cutting, 4K export. With none of the catches: no watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload.

Everything runs locally on a native Rust engine with a GPU compositor. Install it, drop in footage, cut. The AI models for captions, voices and cutout download once and work offline after that. Your footage never leaves your disk.

Auto-captions with local Whisper, text-to-speech with free local voices, background removal, keyframes, 327 GPU-rendered effects, filters and transitions, multi-track cutting and 4K export; a built-in MCP server for AI agents.
